verdict.rationale: Payout scheduling and reconciliation is a fair question for a merchant-of-record payments platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no way to control the payout schedule and no per-payout breakdown of charges, fees, and refunds. The only related item is a community note that fees apply on payouts, which says nothing about schedule control or reconciliation detail.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout
